source.interpretation: Part 3 JSON validation (pinned Edition 4 schemas) is a floor, not a substitute for Part 2 semantics. These assertions are independently authored source mappings, not a certification or execution report.

assertions.assertion: All signed i32 reservation ids, all five create statuses and both cancel statuses are preserved; statusInfo is validated and dropped; replacement lands only on acceptance and a refused replacement keeps the previous owner; CSMS cancellation produces no inferred station update.

An EVSE reservation is admitted only on the exact EVSE resource; an unspecified-EVSE reservation needs explicit NonEvseSpecific support and never binds capacity to one EVSE; connectorType is an exact optional constraint.

A TransactionEvent reservationId ends the reservation only on its EVSE and, when an idToken is present, only for the reserved identity (type plus case-insensitive idToken) or a provider-known group member; group linkage never authorizes, and a transaction report is not an authorization grant.

ReservationStatusUpdate Expired/Removed terminate the single sent live owner after commit and before acknowledgement; an in-flight same-id replacement is ambiguous rather than guessed; trusted expiry runs while offline; the bridge never infers Removed from StatusNotification.

execution_status: Native model, wire, process and storage tests and actual separate-process bridge/simulator smoke executed in isolated software verification; not hardware or OCA certification.
